intro:
Buy. Repair. Sell.
Build the ultimate car dealership empire.
description:
Step into the fast lane of the automotive business in Car Dealership Manager 2026, the ultimate hands-on simulator where every handshake, every repair, and every sale is executed with your own two hands.

Start with a dusty lot and a handful of questionable beaters, then grind your way up to a multi-million dollar luxury showroom empire. This isn't a menu-driven spreadsheet sim — you're walking the floor, popping hoods, inspecting paint jobs, and bringing neglected machines back to life before flipping them for massive profits.

True Hands-On Immersion

Feel the weight of the work. Clean interiors, polish scratched paint, and wrench on engines with detailed, tool-by-tool interaction systems.
Inspect Every Inch: Get up close to check engine blocks, examine the undercarriage, and spot hidden damage in fully photorealistic environments.
Test Drive Your Investments: Take your inventory for a spin to experience how cars handle across different environments.
Push the Limits: Experience a hyper-realistic physics engine and dynamic weather conditions before putting cars on the lot.

Build a Luxury Empire

Design your dealership exactly how you want it. Transition from a greasy garage to an elite, brightly lit luxury showroom that drops jaws the second buyers walk in.
Manage the Hustle: Hire a crew of mechanics, detailers, and sales reps to automate the grind.
Expand Your Turf: Upgrade your offices, expand parking lots, and curate specialized display zones for high-end supercars.

Whether you want to be a ruthless auction hunter, a restoration perfectionist, or a luxury automotive kingpin, Car Dealership Manager 2026 puts the entire business in your hands.

Build your empire. Become the legend.
